source_description_html: The RS Taichi GP-EVO Racing Glove NXT054 is constructed of high quality cowhide leather with a kangaroo leather palm. This leather gloves incorporates TPU knuckle, wrist, and finger protection, Scaphoid Protection System (SPS), and a split armor system on the knuckles which allows for mobility. The GP-EVO Racing Gloves also feature ventilation incorporated into the TPU knuckles, external finger seams, double cuff closure, adjustable closure strap, perforated leather gussets, and an anatomical, pre-curved racer palm.
